dialect.detail: AcuCOBOL-GT / ACUCOBOL dialect indicated by COMP-1 usage for numeric key, 'C$RERR' runtime call for extended file status, 'NO LOCK' clause on READ, and PREVIOUS phrase on READ — all characteristic of ACUCOBOL/AcuCOBOL-GT

purpose.domain_detail: General ledger / firm (company) master file management module, likely part of an accounting or ERP system managing company records (FIRMES = firms/companies in French)
purpose.summary: This is a subprogram module (6-FIRMES) that handles general read/write operations on a FIRME (firm/company) indexed file. It supports forward and backward sequential navigation (START/READ NEXT/PREVIOUS), direct key reads, and write-or-rewrite logic, passing records back via linkage section. It also calls a SQL-related subprogram (9-FIRME) conditionally.

notable_features: COMP-1 used for numeric key (ACUCOBOL style)
C$RERR call for extended file status error handling
DECLARATIVES with USE AFTER ERROR PROCEDURE
EVALUATE on numeric key codes (65=A, 66=B ASCII)
4 COPY statements for file control and linkage
verdict.notes: File uses latin-1 encoding with box-drawing characters in header comment. French naming conventions suggest Belgian or French origin. The program-id '6-FIRMES' with numeric prefix suggests a numbered module in a larger application suite. COMP-1 for a 4-digit key is unusual and strongly points to ACUCOBOL where COMP-1 is a floating-point type — this may be intentional or a dialect quirk.
